h:
⚠️ 警告：不支持 Python 3.12+。仅使用 Python 3.11.8–3.11.9。

此工作流程专为使用 Qwen Image Edit 2511 (Lightning) 生成多角度数据集而设计。

它专注于在多个摄像机角度生成一致的主题表示，使其适合数据集创建、参考生成和训练准备。

每张图片都有相应的名称，并已准备好进行 Lora 培训！

该工作流程不依赖于Lightning步骤LoRA，而是直接使用Lightning基础模型。

可选的多角度 LoRA 支持可实现受控的视角和视图变化，同时保持视觉一致性。

适合使用 ComfyUI 的用户，他们需要为数据集和训练相关的工作流程提供可靠、可重复的多视图图像输出。

o.en:
⚠️ WARNING: Python 3.12+ is NOT supported. Use Python 3.11.8–3.11.9 only.

This workflow is designed for multi-angle dataset production using Qwen Image Edit 2511 (Lightning).

It focuses on generating consistent subject representations across multiple camera angles, making it suitable for dataset creation, reference generation, and training preparation.

Every image has the according name and is ready for Lora-Training!

The workflow does not rely on Lightning step LoRAs and uses the Lightning base model directly.

Optional Multi-Angle LoRA support enables controlled perspective and view variation while maintaining visual consistency.

Intended for users working with ComfyUI who need reliable, repeatable multi-view image outputs for dataset and training-related workflows.
